title: Spire Legacy
description:
Every climb ends. Your bloodline grows.

A solo and co-op Slay the Spire 2 character by CapeKid: Knight, Mage and Ranger heirs, 82 reward cards per class on regular or 85 on public-beta, with 34 shared family cards plus class specialties and three basic starters, 360 registered illustrated cards and upgrades, 61 inherited traits, genetic starter changes and permanent Family Manor upgrades. Name your family, choose its banner and select three new heirs after each climb. Purchases require explicit confirmation; a temporary crown editor supports playtesting.

Requires Slay the Spire 2 and BaseLib. Rogue Legacy 2 is not required. Trait icons, class badges, character sprites, portraits and card illustrations are original mod artwork included in the package. No content extraction or game-derived assets are included. Windows and Linux x86_64 support, including Steam Deck; regular/public-beta compatibility; solo and co-op with independent heirs and local family progression.

Includes seven exclusive relic drops supporting family and class synergies, original class-specific Architect ending dialogue and 48 first/return conversations across eight Ancients, six dedicated class Ancient cards, original class energy/map/cookie presentation, trails and synthesized sounds and recent card/trait balance changes. Native checks pass on regular v0.107.1 and public-beta v0.111.0. Physical Deck and full-run balance retesting remain needed for each release. Original code and artwork: MIT, CapeKid. Slay the Spire 2 belongs to Mega Crit; Rogue Legacy 2 inspiration belongs to Cellar Door Games.
changeNote: 1.0.29: Latest merged main through PR #115. Hardened family saves, purchases and run settlement; stronger co-op ownership and inherited snapshot validation (all peers must use this version); transferred starters use recipient traits; Overcompensation no longer stacks its surcharge on same-turn redraw; corrected Shocked and Diva descriptions. Includes all prior card balancing. Supports regular v0.107.1 and public-beta v0.111.0 with BaseLib 3.4.7.
